title: Impression maths is broken sitewide: impressions 5x'd while clicks stayed flat; non-brand earned 10 clicks in the last 10 days

evidence.claim: Monthly impressions grew 32k (Oct 2025) to 178k (Jun 2026) while monthly clicks stayed flat at 434-626
CTR at positions 5-10 is 0.04-0.13%, far below any classic SERP curve
Question-shaped queries almost never click
evidence.value: 62,656 impressions, 8 clicks (0.013%)

evidence.claim: Recent 10-day window (29 Jul-7 Aug): brand vs non-brand
evidence.value: brand: 1,047 imp / 66 clicks; non-brand: 31,253 imp / 10 clicks

evidence.claim: High-impression queries are largely synthetic/AI-shaped, e.g. company-name + topic mashups
evidence.value: 'causalens engineering challenges nearshoring' 483 imp pos 5.2 0 clicks; 'number of employees at cloudcomunicaciones.cl' 513 imp pos 7.9 0 clicks

impact.estimate: Not a fix itself, but it re-sizes every other fix: 'position 8 to 4 gains N clicks' arithmetic is invalid for most of this impression base. The honest ceiling for on-page quick wins is measured in tens of clicks/month, not hundreds. All estimates below use observed CTRs, not textbook curves.

recommendation: Adopt this frame for the whole roadmap: rank work by the small set of commercial queries that actually click, plus AI-citation presence, not by raw impressions. Also corrects the brief: there is NO 'toptal alternatives' query at position 4 pointing at /alternatives anywhere in the 16-month query x page data; the largest alternatives-family query is 'alternatives to nearshore software development outsourcing' (2,216 imp, pos 4.8, 0 clicks) pointing at /scaling-teams/why-consider-alternatives-to-software-development-outsourcing.

Caitlin Murray: ask Seb (known item, Tech Debt #58).

title: The top striking-distance pages are internally link-starved: /compare/toptal-vs-upwork has 44k impressions at position 7 and one dofollow internal link

evidence.claim: /compare/toptal-vs-upwork: 44,019 impressions 90d, avg pos 7.0, 12 clicks, 0-1 incoming internal links
evidence.value: internal_links_in=0 in crawl; in Ahrefs one-inlink report

evidence.claim: 54 of the 211 one-inlink pages have impressions in the last 90d
evidence.value: top: toptal-vs-upwork 44,019; arc-dev-alternatives guide 5,286; front-end-developers 3,665; android-developers 3,067; laravel-developers 2,544

evidence.claim: Other striking-distance earners are nearly as starved
evidence.value: /nearshoring-offshoring/nearshore-vs-offshore-costs-2026-...: 4 inlinks, 27,802 imp, pos 7.2; /nearshoring-offshoring/what-is-nearshoring-...: 5 inlinks, 47,822 imp, pos 6.5; /technology/swift-developers: 7 inlinks, 645 imp, pos 25.6; vs /services/philippines-developers with 330 inlinks

impact.estimate: Mechanical, safe, reversible. Honest arithmetic: these pages' observed CTR at pos 6-8 is ~0.03-0.09%, so even a 3-position gain on toptal-vs-upwork is single-digit extra clicks/month from the current query mix - BUT the commercial sub-queries that do click ('toptal vs upwork' 54 imp/10d pos 10.5, 'nearshore vs offshore costs' family ~300 imp/10d pos 6-7, 24 clicks/90d on the costs post) are exactly the ones position gains help. Estimate 10-30 extra clicks/month across the set, low confidence.

recommendation: Add contextual internal links from the relevant hubs and top-linked pages (services/technology hubs, related blog posts, /alternatives) to the ~20 one-inlink pages that have real impressions and positions 4-20. Do NOT bulk-link all 211; most of the one-inlink pages earn nothing and are fine as-is.

title: 257 pages contain internal links that point at redirects, including nearly every top impression-earning page

evidence.claim: 257 indexable pages have links to redirects; 76 of them have impressions in the last 90d
evidence.value: includes what-is-nearshoring (47,822 imp), toptal-vs-upwork (44,019), latam staff-aug ranking post (16,642), /reviews (4,874)

evidence.claim: Joined table links_to_redirects column filled on 178 rows
evidence.value: 178 filled

impact.estimate: No measurable click gain on its own; consolidates link equity through one hop instead of two during the exact window Google is re-mapping the migrated site. Cheap, mechanical, zero risk. Likely one shared cause (old Webflow-era hrefs in Sanity content) fixable with a scripted content patch.

recommendation: Aggregate the -links.csv companion file by redirect target, then patch the hrefs in Sanity content (and any hard-coded chrome links) to the final URLs in one scripted pass. Fix the 76 impression-bearing pages first.

title: Philippines cannibalisation cluster: three live indexable pages split the 'hire developers philippines' query family

evidence.claim: /services/philippines-developers, /services/filipino-developers and /hire/philippines-offshoring are all 200 and indexable
evidence.value: status 200 / indexable true on all three

evidence.claim: GSC shows the query family split across them
evidence.value: 'hire developers in the philippines': 1,156 imp pos 12.9 on philippines-developers + 290 imp pos 15.3 on filipino-developers; 'hire developers philippines': 274 imp on filipino-developers + 244 on philippines-developers + 213 on /hire/philippines-offshoring; 'hire software developer philippines': 316 on /hire/philippines-offshoring + 182 on filipino-developers + 152 on philippines-developers; 'filipino developers': 159 + 82 split

evidence.claim: /services/philippines-developers is the canonical strongest page
evidence.value: 330 internal links in, 17,064 imp 90d; filipino-developers and /hire/philippines-offshoring have 0-2 inlinks

evidence.claim: Same pattern on two more pairs
evidence.value: 'hire no code developers': /services/no-code-developers (1,206 imp pos 11.7) vs live duplicate /hire/no-code-developers (204 imp pos 18.8); 'hire full stack developers': /services/full-stack-developers (799 imp) vs live /hire/full-stack-developers (56 imp)

impact.estimate: Consolidating ~1,000 imp/16m of split signals onto the strong page is the classic fix for a family sitting at pos 9-17. The philippines family is one of the few clusters with genuinely commercial queries. Click upside is modest under the QW-01 frame (est. 5-15 clicks/month) but this also removes duplicate-content risk post-migration. Requires a Jake decision on which URLs 301, so NOT a no-decision quick win.

recommendation: Decide canonical per family (recommended: /services/philippines-developers, /services/no-code-developers, /services/full-stack-developers), 301 the duplicates, re-point the internal links. Check first whether /hire/* and /services/filipino-developers exist on the live Webflow parity list deliberately; if they were live on Webflow too this is inherited, not migration-caused, and equally worth fixing.

title: Metadata defects on impression-bearing pages: 20 titles too long, 33 descriptions too long, 9 missing descriptions

evidence.claim: 46 indexable pages have too-long titles; 20 have 90d impressions
evidence.value: top: latam staff-aug ranking post 16,642 imp pos 6.5 (title_length 76); cloud-employee-vs-andela 2,409 imp pos 5.7; /our-work 1,103 imp pos 3.7

evidence.claim: 71 indexable pages have too-long descriptions; 33 have impressions
evidence.value: top: what-is-nearshoring 47,822 imp (desc 177 chars); nearshore-vs-offshore-costs 27,802 imp (desc 197); /reviews 4,874 imp pos 12.9

evidence.claim: 18 indexable pages missing descriptions; 9 have impressions
evidence.value: /legals/general-terms 539 imp; /reviews/salmon-software 183; 7 more /reviews/* detail pages

impact.estimate: Honest sizing under QW-01: these pages collectively earn ~60 clicks/90d today. A best-case CTR improvement from clean titles/descriptions on the pages with clicking queries (costs post: 24 clicks/90d; /reviews: 17) is maybe +20-40% on that subset, i.e. 5-15 clicks/month. Cheap enough to do anyway. The 9 missing descriptions (review detail template + legal template) look like a template-level gap worth one fix, not nine.

recommendation: Fix only the ~30 defect pages with impressions>0: trim titles to <=60 chars, descriptions to <=155, add descriptions to the review-detail and legal templates (template-level defaults from Sanity fields, one change each). Skip the zero-impression rest.

title: Google rewrites the title on all 26 pages Ahrefs flagged for page/SERP title mismatch, including the homepage and every top earner

evidence.claim: 26 of 26 flagged pages have 90d impressions - this defect sits exactly on the pages that matter
evidence.value: / (11,187 imp, 701 clicks), /about-us (27,823 imp, 69 clicks), what-is-nearshoring (47,822), nearshore-vs-offshore-costs (27,802), philippines-developers (17,064), latam ranking post (16,642), typescript-developers (10,487)

impact.estimate: Google rewriting a title usually means the authored title mismatches the dominant query intent. Aligning the 26 authored titles with what Google shows (or a better version of it) is the cheapest CTR lever available on the exact pages with clicks. Overlaps QW-06 on several URLs; do together. Estimate under QW-01 frame: 5-20 clicks/month, low confidence.

recommendation: Pull the SERP title Ahrefs recorded for each of the 26, diff against the authored title, and rewrite the authored one to carry the winning query phrasing (keep live H1s per Tech Debt #43b - this is metaTitle only, a Sanity field edit, no code).
